prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG sheet with TWELVE scrapyard future-expansion source concepts. These are visual ideas, not established content or gameplay. Exact canvas 1536x1152, viewBox 0 0 1536 1152. FOUR columns THREE rows, row-major, each cell 384x384, no gutters. Each subject in its own named top-level group with only the single specified translate, all paths LOCAL to its cell, no painted content outside groups. Keep silhouette within 12%..88% of each cell. Every concept separable, no cross-cell decoration. Transparent outside silhouettes, NO cell backgrounds or shadows. High oblique above view for enemy sprites, compact object view for machinery. Dark forest ink #142622, shadow #30483e, steel #a5b4a2, cream #e9dbb7, restrained copper #b97c5e; sparse role accents. Broad connected cut planes and strong asymmetrical contours. Enemies read at 30 and 20px; workshop objects read at 38 and 24px. Fewer than 16 broad filled shapes per object, no thin lines or wispy isolated parts.
Cohesive engraved fantasy illustration grounded in the actual game, upper-left light, strong distinct silhouettes, broad modeled planes before sparse accents. No realistic gun designs, modern logos, glyph labels, numbers, visible text, card borders, stats or UI. No lantern, mirror or anvil; no existing runtime role is replaced. No automatic upgrades or invented rules.

Cell 1: group id="cable-winch" transform="translate(0 0)": WORKSHOP: squat drum winch with a thick wound cable passing through fitted guide rollers, asymmetrical crank; copper steel.
Cell 2: group id="flywheel-press" transform="translate(384 0)": WORKSHOP: broad flywheel side silhouette drives a closed press head over thick platen, visible joined arm, no anvil.
Cell 3: group id="condenser-tower" transform="translate(768 0)": WORKSHOP: squat twin unequal pressure tanks joined by thick curved pipe and fin cap; pale teal accent.
Cell 4: group id="sorting-magnet" transform="translate(1152 0)": WORKSHOP: suspended horseshoe electromagnet in a low A-frame, three broad attached metal chunks; no particles.
Cell 5: group id="treadle-shear" transform="translate(0 384)": WORKSHOP: wide open steel cutting jaws above a low foot lever, hinged into one strong bracket; ochre accent.
Cell 6: group id="battery-cradle" transform="translate(384 384)": WORKSHOP: two unequal rectangular battery blocks seated in a braced charging cradle, thick cable loop; muted acid-green strip.
Cell 7: group id="sawback-crawler" transform="translate(768 384)": ENEMY: broad low beetle-like tracked machine, one thick serrated steel back arch, two visible short tread feet; rust dominant, no human hood.
Cell 8: group id="bellows-leaper" transform="translate(1152 384)": ENEMY: compact bent mechanical spring legs carry a wedge leather bellows body, large negative space beneath lifted front, coral dominant.
Cell 9: group id="coil-stalker" transform="translate(0 768)": ENEMY: narrow leaning steel torso with a single heavy bent coil at its back, two stout unequal connected legs, pale teal dominant.
Cell 10: group id="bucket-shield" transform="translate(384 768)": ENEMY: heavy inverted bucket helmet integrated into broad asymmetrical shield torso and two squat feet, ivory/ochre dominant, no brute shoulder copy.
Cell 11: group id="wheel-impeller" transform="translate(768 768)": ENEMY: a single thick tilted wheel with two fitted stabilizer feet and crescent guard, plum body, pale steel rim, no detached spikes.
Cell 12: group id="clamp-crab" transform="translate(1152 768)": ENEMY: squat crab-shaped salvage machine, two unequal joined clamp forearms and four short load-bearing feet, sage/copper planes.
Native self-contained vector paths and simple shapes only, explicit flat paint. No raster, image, script, animation, use, external resources, gradients, filters, masks or defs. A finished coherent sibling set with useful negative space, no fine repetitive hatching. Each group extracts as an independent SVG with no lost resources.
